subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should OpenClaw support model/provider overrides for `main` + `systemEvent` cron jobs, and should that public contract be `payload.model`, top-level cron fields, or an explicit session override block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the choice affects public cron schema, provider validation, session override precedence, UI display, docs, and upgrade compatibility.

options.title: Add a first-class cron override contract
options.body: Choose one public shape and require runtime, protocol, UI, docs, and tests to honor the same model/provider precedence for main-session system events.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document that per-job model selection is supported for model-backed agent-turn jobs and leave system events tied to the target session model.

options.title: Fold into broader task routing
options.body: Track this with adjacent heartbeat/task model override work so scheduled-work surfaces do not grow incompatible provider-routing semantics.

recommendation.title: Add a first-class cron override contract
recommendation.body: Choose one public shape and require runtime, protocol, UI, docs, and tests to honor the same model/provider precedence for main-session system events.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent routing signal through merged isolated cron model behavior and adjacent cron UI proof work.
